reviewNotes: HOLD. Current Claro Colombia material establishes an active prepaid product, COP1,000 minimum online recharge, 60-day recharge validity, a stated risk of line deactivation after 60 days without movements, expired-balance recovery, and prepaid roaming where incoming SMS is free in supported destinations. Current initial foreign-user SIM registration and mainland-China prepaid roaming are not established, so the route remains HOLD.

events.outcome: Current Claro Colombia prepaid evidence establishes a COP1,000 recharge floor, 60-day recharge validity, line-deactivation risk after 60 days without movements and free incoming roaming SMS in supported prepaid destinations; foreign-user initial registration and mainland-China coverage remain unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: Claro Colombia currently sells prepaid physical SIMs; the reviewed online store lists a SIM with a 20-day package at COP15,000, including a COP3,000 SIM component. This is a current retail offer rather than a permanent minimum acquisition floor.

keep.action: Claro states that online recharges from COP1,000 are valid for 60 calendar days, and that a prepaid line with no movements for 60 days could be deactivated. A COP1,000 recharge is one documented way to create activity, but the provider wording does not prove that recharge is the only qualifying movement or guarantee an exact day-60 cancellation, so no invented annual keep cost is stored.

data.chinaActivation: Current acquisition is Colombia-local. A current foreign-passport initial prepaid registration workflow and China-first activation were not established.
data.kyc: Current Mi Claro account access can use several identity types including passport, but that is not proof of initial SIM registration eligibility. The reviewed current pages do not establish a general foreign-passport new-line registration path.
data.payment: Claro provides current online and exterior-recharge surfaces. Exact foreign-card/processor eligibility was not established from the reviewed material; keep this constraint explicit.
data.roamingSms: Claro’s current prepaid roaming page explicitly says prepaid users can receive SMS abroad at no cost in supported destinations while sending SMS is unavailable. Mainland China was not established in the reviewed current prepaid coverage list, and third-party OTP delivery remains unverified.
data.holdReason: Initial foreign-user registration and mainland-China prepaid roaming/OTP support remain unresolved; the 60-day no-movement rule is a deactivation risk threshold rather than a guaranteed exact cancellation clock.
data.tariffSummary: COP1,000 minimum online recharge; recharge validity 60 days; Claro says 60 days without movements can risk line deactivation. Prepaid roaming receives SMS free in supported destinations; foreign-user registration/China remain unresolved; HOLD.
guideSteps: Create a qualifying movement before the 60-day inactivity threshold; do not convert the provider’s “could be deactivated” wording into a guaranteed exact cancellation day.
Treat free incoming roaming SMS as supported-destination carrier evidence, not proof of third-party OTP delivery.
Do not claim mainland-China support or foreign-passport initial registration until current provider evidence establishes them.
